stellar_skills.name: Holdup
lines: Fire type piercing attack on all enemies x5 (XXL, increase skill damage 5 times 5x of the standard skill multiplier of 210% )
* When 8+ Retro Count are stacked: Consume 8 Retro Count to Activate Tri-assault, Blaze Impact and Vigilant Lance
* When 8+ Clock Count are stacked: Consume 8 Clock Count to stack Jamming on all enemies
** Jamming: Power and Intelligence -100%, Consumes one stack at end of turn, if user dies consumes all stacks
* Retro or Clock Count do not stack when using this skill
* When used during Stellar Burst: Skill multiplier +400% (Multiplier x5) and does not consume Retro or Clock Count stacks
